text: With seeds 20-23, 4 layers, d_model=64, 3000 steps and e<=0.5 held fixed, where between N=64 (force margin 0.21-0.26) and N=256 (0.03-0.04) does the force margin collapse? Would an N=128 arm separate a sharp threshold from a gradual decline in log N, and does the accel_step control R2 (0.80 at N=16, 0.77-0.79 at N=64, 0.65-0.68 at N=256) fall in step with it?
